games.name: Minigolf
games.howTo: Pull back in your half and let go. The course turns to face the shooter.
games.handicap: Longer aim guide, and strokes off the score

games.name: Air Hockey
games.howTo: Drag your paddle around your half and hit the puck into the far goal.
games.handicap: Bigger paddle, wider goal to shoot at

games.name: Sumo
games.blurb: Push the other wrestler out. Best of 3.
games.howTo: Hold your side to stop turning and charge; let go to dash where the arrow points.
games.handicap: Heavier wrestler, more room and more rope saves at the edge

games.name: Ping Pong
games.howTo: Slide to move your paddle. Flick hard as you hit to SMASH; swipe across the ball to curve it.
games.handicap: Bigger paddle, slower ball toward you

games.name: Snack Snatch
games.blurb: Most points in 30 seconds. Gold is worth 3.
games.howTo: Tap left or right to snap that critter at the snacks. A miss makes it dizzy.

games.name: Tank Duel
games.howTo: Push your stick to turn and drive (a little push just turns). Tap FIRE. Shells bounce off blocks, so watch out for your own!
games.handicap: Extra armor: more bonks to knock out

games.name: Snake Duel
games.howTo: Tap your left or right button to turn your snake. Walls and trails crash you. Make the other snake crash first!
games.handicap: Slower snake, turn assist near walls

games.name: Penalty Shootout
games.blurb: Five kicks each, then sudden death.
games.howTo: Shooter: swipe at the goal. Keeper: tap a dive button; dive too soon and the shooter can switch.
games.handicap: Bigger goal and keeper, longer clock

games.name: Quick Draw
games.blurb: Tap first on DRAW! Best of 5.
games.howTo: Wait for DRAW!, then tap your button. A tap too early, or on a fake-out, loses the round.
games.handicap: Opponent's tap counts a little later

games.name: Chop Chop
games.blurb: Last one chopping, or first to 50. Best of 5.
games.howTo: Tap left or right to chop from that side. Dodge the falling branches!

games.name: Sea Battle
games.howTo: Shuffle or move your 5 ships, pass the phone, then take turns: tap a square, tap again to fire. A hit fires again.

games.name: Four in a Row
games.blurb: Four in a line. Best of 3.
games.howTo: On your turn, tap (or slide and let go) on your side to drop a disc in that column.
games.handicap: Hint glow on winning and blocking moves

games.name: Checkers
games.blurb: Take every piece, or leave no move.
games.howTo: Tap a piece, then where it goes. Jumps are compulsory and must be finished. Reach the far row to become a king.
games.handicap: An undo per star, and a hint glow from two stars

games.name: Tic-Tac-Toe
games.howTo: X goes first. Take turns tapping a square; three in a row wins the game. Draws don't count.

games.name: Rock Paper Scissors
games.howTo: Both pick in secret, then reveal. With two people the phone turns to one player at a time while the other looks away.
